description: This file defines the 'Multiplexer' class which implements the 'ReporterV2' interface, managing multiple reporters for test reporting. It includes methods for handling test lifecycle events, output streams, configuration, and errors, as well as utility functions for error handling.

classes.name: Multiplexer
classes.description: A class that multiplexes test reporting events to multiple reporter instances.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Handles configuration setup for all reporters.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Called at the start of a test suite.

methods.name: onTestPaused
methods.description: Handles pausing of a test asynchronously.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Called at the start of a test step.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Called at the end of a test step.

methods.name: printsToStdio
methods.description: Determines if any reporter outputs to stdio.
